'''October 1999 Phoenix tournament (Arizona Gamer)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Arizona Gamer, Phoenix, Arizona on 2 October 1999. It is known from Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d66">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-06-az-gamer-phoenix-10-2-99d66/ az-gamer-phoenix-10-2-99], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 6 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-06-az-gamer-phoenix-10-2-99d66/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 October 1999
* '''Site:''' Arizona Gamer, Phoenix, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 8
